jobs.title: Software Engineer - Data Solutions, AI & Data Platform (AiDP)

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help build next\- generation of Applied Machine Learning Data Platforms. Applied Machine Learning Data Platform team provides platform engineering, data engineering tools, data pipelines, and services for various Machine Learning and Analyst teams. These help to train and deploy inference models, and run data analytics at scale to prevent Fraud and automate decisioning on multiple Apple Platforms like Apple Pay, Apple Media Products, App Store, Online Store, Retail, AppleCare and Manufacturing. We're looking for a Software Engineer with a strong data background and deep platform\-thinking to design, build, and enhance a scalable, efficient data platform.  

  

You'll bring hands\-on experience in data warehousing and analytics, and thrive on solving hard, large\-scale data problems. If you're passionate about building production\-grade platforms and want to make a lasting impact at scale, we'd love to talk to you.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Nimble Brain
jobs.description:
**About Nimble**



Nimble is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to power fast, efficient and economical commerce. We’re training robot AGI to power a proprietary generalist supply chain superhumanoid, the first robot in the world capable of performing thousands of tasks across the supply chain. We’ve raised over $220M at over $1B valuation and formed a strategic alliance with FedEx to build a national network of autonomous warehouses capable of generating many billions in annual revenue. We are a hardcore and obsessed team of the world’s best engineers and operators. If you are obsessed with your craft, enjoy a high\-intensity and fast moving high impact environment, are super high agency in getting hard things done and want to be part of building the world’s most legendary robotics company at the most pivotal moment in history, we want to work with you.



We are on a mission to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial. We will accomplish this by training robot AGI to invent and build the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – powered by generalist superhumanoids.



Our founding team comes from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon and our board of directors include famed robotics and AI legends including Fei\-Fei Li (Chief Scientist of AI at Google and Director of Stanford’s AI Lab), Marc Raibert (founder of Boston Dynamics), and Sebastian Thrun (founder of GoogleX, Waymo; Stanford Professor and considered the father of autonomous vehicles).



Let’s be legendary.


**About the Role**



Nimble is looking for a **Robotics Software Engineer** to build the core software powering our next\-generation autonomous robots. In this role, you will develop the systems that allow our robots to operate with exceptional reliability, precision, and efficiency in real production environments.



You will work across robot control, sensing, runtime execution, and backend services—building robust, production\-grade software that scales as we deploy more robots into high\-throughput warehouse operations. You’ll collaborate closely with our AI, hardware, and infrastructure teams to integrate frontier AI capabilities into practical, real\-world robotics systems and to continually improve robot uptime, performance, and overall intelligence.



This is a rare opportunity to help define the software foundation of industry\-leading intelligent robots and contribute to the long\-term vision of generalized robotic autonomy at scale.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Design and implement core robotic software for **real\-time control, manipulation, sensing pipelines, and high\-reliability task execution**.
* Build tools and workflows for **sensor data processing, visualization, validation, and debugging** across development and production environments.
* Create **automated evaluation, and remote operations**.
* Work closely with AI research teams to integrate new **frontier AI models** into production robot behaviors, ensuring predictable and safe performance.
* Collaborate with hardware engineering on seamless software–hardware integration for new robot platforms and upgrades.
* Contribute hands\-on to testing, profiling, and optimizing our systems for **robustness, low latency, and operational uptime**.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related engineering field.
* 1\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems.
* Experience integrating with robotics, IoT, or embedded device SDKs.
* Proven ability to design, implement, and maintain **complex, high\-reliability software systems**.
* Hands\-on development experience in **Rust**.
* Familiarity with software best practices including testing, documentation, code reviews, and robust architectural design.
* Excellent communication, ownership, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $140,000 and $230,000/year. Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this position will also receive generous equity for this position.  


**Culture**
We embrace challenges and strive to make the impossible possible each day. We’re not in this to do what’s easy or to be mediocre. We want to create something legendary and leave our mark on the world. We’re ambitious, we’re gritty, we’re humble and we’re relentlessly resourceful in pursuit of our goals. If this sounds like you then you might be a great fit!

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Generative UI, Input Experience
jobs.description:
Most interfaces are designed months before anyone uses them. We're building the ones that aren't \- interfaces composed on demand, in response to what someone asked for, or what they're about to need.  

  

The biggest decisions are still ahead: what the frameworks look like, where the runtime boundary sits, how we tell a good generated interface from a bad one. You'd be making them \- working out how to meet the craft and polish people expect from Apple without giving up the range and surprise that make generative UI exciting.  

  

**Description**  

  

As one of the first engineers on a newly formed team, you will partner directly with Apple's design studio and AI teams to invent this paradigm. You'll help set the technical direction, shape the team's culture, and establish the bar for our engineering.  

  

One half of the job is interface craft: layout, motion, responsiveness, and the thousand details that make something feel native. The other half is building the system that decides at runtime what the interface should even be \- generating something a designer would normally draw.  

  

The work in front of us: productizing the execution runtime and hardening the security boundary around it; driving generation quality through prompt iteration, automated evaluation, and output validation; designing the UI frameworks that generated interfaces are built from; and shipping the features that people rely on. This requires a rare balance: rapid, highly ambiguous design exploration to find what feels right, followed by the rigorous engineering required to ship cross\-platform frameworks at Apple scale. You will partner with AI/ML teams, app teams, framework owners, security engineers, and designers across Apple to take features from idea to shipping.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Because this is a foundational role on a new team, we don't expect you to have every skill listed below. We are looking for deep expertise in a few areas, and the engineering fundamentals to learn the rest:  

  

Experience productizing a language runtime, interpreter, or VM under real workloads  

  

Experience designing a DSL, schema, or API surface that another system or model generates against  

  

Familiarity with sandboxing untrusted code and mediating its access to data and system capabilities  

  

Ability to reason adversarially about an API surface  

  

Experience defending against prompt injection \- guardrails, trust boundaries for retrieved content, personal data in context  

  

Experience evaluating nondeterministic systems: golden sets, automated judges, metrics that track what users notice  

  

Hands\-on experience with prompt design, tool definitions, structured output, and output validation  

  

Experience shipping a production ML\-backed feature at scale  

  

Strong design sensibility, and the judgment to tell when a generated interface isn't good enough  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

6\+ years of software engineering experience  

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  

  

Expert\-level Swift, with production SwiftUI (or comparable declarative UI)  

  

Led an application or framework end to end, including its public API and its adopters  

  

Hands\-on experience building user\-facing features with generative models (shipped or prototyped)  

  

Experience setting technical direction across teams and mentoring engineers  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: Data Center Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** IT Engineer

**Location:** Santa Clara

**Duration:** 12 months

**Note**: This is a W2 only role — C2C, C2H will not be considered

**Position Overview:** We are seeking an IT Engineer to support the design, development, and ongoing management of infrastructure within office and laboratory environments in Santa Clara, California. This role partners closely with facilities teams, business stakeholders, network engineers, and hardware engineering teams to deliver scalable infrastructure solutions that support critical technology operations.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical lead for low voltage infrastructure projects, manage network room engineering activities, support construction initiatives, and contribute to the development of global infrastructure standards and engineering practices.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead construction engineering efforts for office and laboratory infrastructure projects.
* Partner with facilities teams and business stakeholders to define infrastructure requirements.
* Collaborate with network and audiovisual engineering teams to gather and document technical requirements.
* Define equipment placement within network rooms, including security systems, building automation systems, network racks, and service provider demarcation areas.
* Develop construction documentation and technical specifications for low voltage contractors.
* Participate in contractor bidding processes and support vendor selection activities.
* Conduct routine construction site visits and provide project feedback and status reporting.
* Maintain project closeout records, warranty documentation, and project deliverables.
* Document network rooms and infrastructure assets using asset management platforms, including NetBox and spreadsheet based import tools.
* Serve as the regional point of contact for network room engineering activities.
* Track utilization and capacity of network ports, fiber infrastructure, power distribution units, and related resources.
* Configure and connect intelligent power distribution units and UPS systems while partnering with monitoring teams to establish alerting thresholds.
* Support infrastructure initiatives through equipment installation, rack integration, and cabling efforts.
* Audit IT environments regularly to validate asset records, identify changes, and improve room organization and cable management.
* Collaborate with global engineering team members to enhance infrastructure standards and best practices.
* Lead engineering initiatives by creating roadmaps, defining workflows, planning budgets, and tracking projects through completion.

**Qualifications:**

**Required Qualifications**

* Five or more years of experience in telecommunications consulting, construction project management, low voltage infrastructure, or related technical disciplines.
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure components and architectures.
* Ability to work onsite several days per week within the Santa Clara area.
* Ability to lift, install, inspect, and support equipment within network rack environments.
* Demonstrated interest in technology and technical infrastructure disciplines.
* Strong problem solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.
* Availability to collaborate across multiple time zones supporting global teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) certification.
* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or comparable education and experience.
* Experience with Autodesk solutions, including AutoCAD and Revit.
* Familiarity with Bluebeam Studio.

**Tools and Technologies:**

* Network Infrastructure
* Telecommunications Systems
* Low Voltage Construction
* NetBox Asset Management
* Intelligent Power Distribution Units
* Uninterruptible Power Supply Systems
* Fiber Infrastructure
* AutoCAD
* Revit
* Bluebeam Studio
* Microsoft Excel

Pay: $45\.00 \- $47\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in low\-voltage, telecommunications, IT infrastructure, or network infrastructure engineering?

Work Location: In person
